scope_chat: Chat with your models (text, attached images, the application's tools)
scope_embed: Compute embeddings (represent text so it can be found again), on this PC
circle_mine_help: the ones I paired as “my machines”
circle_friends: My friends who lend their computing power
circle_friends_help: only if “Automatic mode: let my friends' machines answer too” is on, or if the app names a machine
content_notice: The text, images and documents the application sends go to the machine that computes, only while it computes, without being kept there: uncheck a circle to exclude it. AIODOS sends nothing to the cloud. What the application then does with what it receives is up to it alone.
program_seen_html: Program seen by Windows: {program}, under your Windows account.
program_unknown: Unknown program: AIODOS couldn't see which program is asking.
program_generic: Generic program (interpreter): any script can use it.
not_served_yet: not served by this version yet: you'll be asked again when it arrives
title: An application is asking to use AIODOS
name_unverified: That's the name the program gives: AIODOS can't verify it.
code_check: This code must be showing in {name} right now. If it's different, or if you didn't ask for anything, deny the request.
can_do: What {name} will be able to do
background: Its requests come after my background work (low priority)
pin: Bind the key to this program: reject any other program that tries to use it
opens_apps: AIODOS will open to applications on this PC (127.0.0.1 only).
